author: Simplilearn
description:
In this video, Ethical Hacker Roadmap 2026, we break down a practical step-by-step path for beginners who want to become an ethical hacker in six months. If you’re starting from scratch and confused about what to learn first, this roadmap gives you complete clarity.

We start with the foundations — Linux basics using Kali Linux and core networking concepts like TCP/IP and ports. Then we move into reconnaissance using tools like Nmap and hands-on labs from TryHackMe and OverTheWire.

Next, we cover web security fundamentals, including SQL injection, XSS, and the OWASP Top 10 vulnerabilities. You’ll also understand exploitation basics with Metasploit, privilege escalation, and password cracking techniques.

Finally, we discuss building real lab experience, creating a portfolio, preparing for certifications, and getting ready for junior cybersecurity roles. With just 1–2 hours of daily practice, you can build strong ethical hacking skills step by step.

#EthicalHackerRoadmap #EthicalHack
title: Ethical Hacker Roadmap 2026 | Beginner to Job-Ready in 6 Months
